name: Quibbly (LinkedIn MCP)
description: Hosted LinkedIn inbox MCP (OAuth): read the LinkedIn conversations and connections synced by the Quibbly Chrome extension, see who watched your videos, set follow-ups, tags and notes, find attachments, and draft replies or first messages that wait in Quibbly until you click Send. Never sends on its own; works alongside any CRM connector. 31 tools; requires a paid Quibbly Solo Pro or team plan.
author: Quibbly (Scriptify Inc)
